question: How must the tip of the trident be grasped and held in this described form?
premises: The trident-tip is the object designated to be grasped.
The grasping is to be done by the boon-giving hand.
The trident-tip is described as held in that grasp.
inference: The tip of the trident is to be grasped by the boon-giving hand and held accordingly.
uncertainties: The analysis and meaning of tryajatho are uncertain in this context.
plain_english: The tip of the trident should indeed be grasped by the boon-giving hand and held.
